title: Revelation of the Echelon surveillance system

tellings.quote: one of the biggest stories I did in my time in Australia was I revealed the existence exclusively of the Echelon communications surveillance system,

plain: In the 1990s, while working in Australia, the journalist Ross Coulthart says he exclusively revealed the existence of Echelon, a secret communications surveillance system run with Australia's intelligence partners in the Five Eyes alliance. He tells Michels this as one of the biggest stories of his career, to show he has broken a hidden government programme before.
